steps.en: Install the CLI from PyPI and register its skills into your agent host
steps.zh: 从 PyPI 装 CLI，把技能注册进 agent 宿主
steps.code: python3 -m pip install --upgrade loopx · loopx workflow-skills --install

steps.en: Connect the project from its root (or paste one message and let your agent do it)
steps.zh: 在项目根目录 connect，或粘一条消息让 agent 代办

steps.en: Create or reuse durable goal state and report the current gate and top todo
steps.zh: 创建或复用目标状态，汇报当前门禁与首条 todo

steps.en: State the long-horizon objective in one line
The heartbeat wakes your existing agent, which must ask the kernel before acting
steps.zh: 心跳唤醒你已有的 agent，动手前先问内核

steps.en: It claims one bounded todo, executes a turn, writes back evidence and the next todo
steps.zh: 认领一片有界任务，执行一轮，写回证据与下一条
steps.code: loopx todo claim · loopx todo update

steps.en: When a decision is yours, it stops and asks a concrete question instead of guessing
steps.zh: 该你拍板时，它停下来问一个具体问题，而不是猜

steps.en: Read the evidence packet and record your gate decisions
steps.zh: 读证据交接包，落门禁决策

value.en: The loop keeps moving across days, restarts and even a harness swap; you show up only at concrete decisions
value.zh: 跨天、重启、换宿主，循环照常推进；你只出现在具体的决策点
